notes.title: Win A Free Copy Of VRNinja!
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE 2: [i]And the contest is now over! Thank you to everyone who participated! The winner was twitter user [url=https://twitter.com/BraeuerChris]@BraeuerChris[/url]![/i][/b]

[b]UPDATE: The contest now ends on September 15th, at 12:00PM MDT![/b]

Hey everyone!

To celebrate the upcoming launch of VRNinja on Steam, we're going to be giving away a free copy of the game! Entering the draw is extremely easy: Simply retweet and like [url=https://twitter.com/MADSOFT/status/771414565254901761]this tweet[/url] and [url=http://twitter.com/madsoft]follow @MADSOFT on Twitter[/url].

[url=https://twitter.com/MADSOFT/status/771414565254901761][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26091344/a0dd983bf1ed35c6b273910d319cb522a1899072.png[/img][/url]

The contest ends on [strike]September 14th[/strike] September 15th at 12:00 PM MDT, just in time for the release of VRNinja on Steam. A winner will be drawn at random and contacted via Twitter DM.!

You can also help us out FOR FREE by [url=https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/46082-vrninja]signing up to the game’s Thunderclap campaign.[/url] Simply choose your favourite social media account (Twitter, Facebook, or tumblr) and you’ll send out a message announcing the game’s release on September 14th! With this little gesture, you’ll be helping a small indie games company get some big support, so thank you in advance!

notes.title: VRNinja Launches On The Oculus Store!
notes.content:
Can't wait for the Steam release of the game? Own an Oculus Rift? Today is your lucky day, ninja hopefuls!

No longer must you put your life on the line to experience the thrill of dodging deadly weapons in your own home! No more furniture will need to be reupholstered, no more cracked televisions replaced! Never again will you be forced to smash your face into a real bowl of ramen to witness the power of slow-mo!

Now you can experience what it really takes to become a ninja — [i]but in VIRTUAL REALITY![/i]

VRNinja, the fast-paced virtual reality game from OutOfBounds Software Solutions Inc., [b]is available to purchase RIGHT NOW on the Oculus Store for the Oculus Rift![/b]

[url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/922069171248456/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26091344/4d14c71864a1c8bba7b49235689a35bf86d5e9f7.png[/img][/url]

You can also enter our contest to win a free copy of the game by retweeting and liking [url=https://twitter.com/MADSOFT/status/771414565254901761]this tweet[/url], and [url=http://twitter.com/MADSOFT]following @MADSOFT on Twitter[/url]. The contest ends September 14th at 12:00 PM MDT, just in time for the release of VRNinja on Steam. A winner will be drawn at random and contacted via Twitter DM.

[url=https://twitter.com/MADSOFT/status/771414565254901761][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26091344/a0dd983bf1ed35c6b273910d319cb522a1899072.png[/img][/url]

You help us out FOR FREE by signing up to [url=https://www.thunderclap.it/projects/46082-vrninja]the game’s Thunderclap campaign.[/url] Simply choose your favourite social media account (Twitter, Facebook, or tumblr) and you’ll send out a message announcing the game’s release on September 14th! With this little gesture, you’ll be helping a small indie games company get some big support, so thank you in advance!

[url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/rift/922069171248456/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26091344/6d2825924ee4f22efdbda0e25dc4511600a01dfd.png[/img][/url]

Enough talk. Now, it is [i]time to DODGE![/i]

[b][i]Note: To those of you with HTC Vive headsets (or if you're simply waiting to get the game on Steam): No worries! VRNinja is still set to release on Steam on September 14th![/i][/b]
